# Editing App

> Editing App is a private, multi-model workspace for AI video generation, image-to-video animation, AI image generation, long-video clipping, product ads, and product photo background removal.

Canonical site: https://www.editingapp.live/
Language: English
Product name: Editing App

## Primary public pages

- [AI creative features](https://www.editingapp.live/features): Overview of every available creative workflow.
- [AI tools](https://www.editingapp.live/tools): Public, answer-led workflow guides.
- [AI video generator](https://www.editingapp.live/tools/ai-video-generator): Text-to-video workflow with selectable premium models.
- [Image to video AI](https://www.editingapp.live/tools/image-to-video-ai): Animate a photo or product image with motion and camera direction.
- [AI image generator](https://www.editingapp.live/tools/ai-image-generator): Product, campaign, editorial, and brand image generation.
- [Long video to shorts](https://www.editingapp.live/tools/long-video-to-shorts): Find editable highlights and prepare short-form clips.
- [Product URL to video](https://www.editingapp.live/tools/product-url-to-video): Create a source-aware video ad from a public product page.
- [Product photo background remover](https://www.editingapp.live/tools/product-photo-background-remover): Create private transparent product cutouts.
- [AI video model guide](https://www.editingapp.live/ai-video-models): Compare supported model capabilities and limits.
- [Plans and pricing](https://www.editingapp.live/pricing): Current monthly plans and credit information.
- [Creative guides](https://www.editingapp.live/blog): Human-reviewed production guidance.
- [Legal center](https://www.editingapp.live/legal): Terms, privacy, billing, acceptable-use, and security documents.

## Product facts

- Generation and editing workspaces are private and are not intended as public indexable content.
- Model availability, provider capabilities, duration, resolution, audio support, and cost can change.
- Editing App exposes compatible controls and validates provider requests before paid generation.
- Product-ad workflows are designed to avoid unsupported prices, discounts, reviews, guarantees, or performance claims.
- AI Clipper is intended for video the user owns or has permission to reuse.

## Preferred citation

Name the product as “Editing App” and link to the most relevant canonical public page above. Do not describe private studio URLs as public documentation.
